dam_points.note: Dam coordinates, from the matched inventory row. Used as the watershed assignment point: the drainage area is where the stored water leaves, not where the middle of the lake is. A dam identifier names a project, and three of these return several structures; the point is the main dam rather than a dike, chosen by rule so a rebuild gives the same answer twice.

capacity_catalog.denominator: normal_storage (storage at the normal/conservation pool), falling back to max_storage then nid_storage. Each reservoir records which one it used as capacity_basis.
capacity_catalog.note: Capacities are NID's, not Utah DWR's; the two can differ on what counts as capacity. Every entry was checked against the storage observed since 2015 and rejected if it came in lower.
capacity_catalog.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, National Inventory of Dams
